_readme: Hand-maintained display names for enemy actor classes the game's own name
table doesn't name, or names unhelpfully. Add one line per class:
Keys are the actor class name (the `key` field of a row in
hash. An override rewrites that row's `text` in EVERY locale — these are
community English names for actors the game leaves as raw class names, and
the non-en tables carry the same untranslated fallback, so there is nothing
to preserve by scoping to en.
This file is the single source for both consumers. The app applies it at
src/i18n.ts); the companion site reads THIS FILE from the gbfr checkout in
gbfr-logs-db/scripts/build_gamedata.py, so after editing run that script and
A key with no matching row is a no-op (the app warns in dev): the app can
only rewrite rows that already exist, since it has no gbfr_hash to mint one.
Overriding a name the game DOES ship is allowed but rarely right — prefer it
only where the shipped name is ambiguous between two distinct actors.
